changeSet.sql: UPDATE drink_library SET volume_ml = COALESCE(volume_ml, ( SELECT CAST(NULLIF(s.volume_ml, '') AS INTEGER) FROM drink_library_nutrition_seed s WHERE CAST(s.drink_id AS UUID) = drink_library.id)), kcal_per_serving = COALESCE(kcal_per_serving, ( SELECT CAST(NULLIF(s.kcal_per_serving, '') AS INTEGER) FROM drink_library_nutrition_seed s WHERE CAST(s.drink_id AS UUID) = drink_library.id)) WHERE id IN (SELECT CAST(drink_id AS UUID) FROM drink_library_nutrition_seed);

rollback.sql: UPDATE drink_library SET volume_ml = NULL, kcal_per_serving = NULL

changeSet.author: claude
claude
changeSet.sql: UPDATE drink_catalog SET volume_ml = COALESCE(volume_ml, (SELECT l.volume_ml FROM drink_library l WHERE l.id = drink_catalog.library_drink_id)), kcal_per_serving = COALESCE(kcal_per_serving, (SELECT l.kcal_per_serving FROM drink_library l WHERE l.id = drink_catalog.library_drink_id)) WHERE library_drink_id IS NOT NULL;
